ImageDescription.value:
Art, Science, Religion, and Education - we have it all in Waterloo.

The church in front is Knox Presbyterian Church. Behind that is the Canadian Clay and Glass Gallery. The black building is the Perimeter Institute for Theoretical Physics. And in the distance is the Dana Porter Library at the University of Waterloo.

Shot with a 160mm (35 mm equivalent) lens from the Uptown Waterloo parking garage.
